title: Creator of Side Quests: multi-page brand site with admin-managed shop (Stripe + quote), portfolio/testimonials CMS, coupons, loyalty points, and giveaway wheel

requirements.text: Create a responsive multi-page marketing website for “The Creator of Side Quests” with the following routes/pages and user-facing copy (in English) based on the provided prompt: Home (hero with headline/subheadline/CTAs/quotes), About (bio + vision/mission/emission + quotes), Services (categories + micro-services + “starting at” placeholders + KY guidance + quotes), Shop, Portfolio, Testimonials, Contact (form with specified fields + response-time guidance + quotes), Hours & Policies (hours, payments/quotes, scope/licensing, returns/adjustments, local service area, anti-discrimination + quote). Include CTAs throughout linking to Contact/booking and Shop/Services as specified.

quotes: Create a fully functional, free website for The Creator of Side Quests...
Multi-page structure: Homepage, About, Services, Shop, Contact, Hours & Policies, Portfolio, Testimonials.

acceptanceCriteria: Navigation allows reaching Home, About, Services, Shop, Portfolio, Testimonials, Contact, Hours & Policies, and Admin pages.

Home page includes the specified headline “Side quests accepted. Main quests optional.”, subheadline, primary CTA “Start Your Side Quest”, secondary CTA “Explore Services & Creations”, and the listed quotes.
About page includes Joseph Fitchpatrick (aka Joe/Willow) intro and vision/mission/emission statements and the listed quotes.
Services page includes all listed service categories, customization messaging, quotes, and Kentucky-specific sales tax/occupational license guidance.
Contact page includes fields: Name, Email, Project Type, Timeline, Budget, Project Description, plus 24–72 hours response-time guidance.
Hours & Policies page contains all specified sections including anti-discrimination policy and the quote “Creative work is built on trust, clarity, and communication.”
All pages render correctly on mobile, tablet, and desktop without layout breakage.

requirements.text: Apply a consistent premium medieval-fantasy visual theme across the entire frontend using deep mossy greens and dark tones, elegant serif + sans-serif typography pairing, subtle textured backgrounds, and tasteful motion (hover effects, smooth transitions, subtle animations) while keeping content energetic, readable, human-centered, and approachable (neurodivergent-chaotic but professional tone). Do not use a blue/purple primary palette.

quotes: ...sleek, chic, medieval-fantasy, premium feel, using deep mossy greens, dark tones, elegant serif/sans-serif typography, textured backgrounds, subtle animations...

acceptanceCriteria: All pages share a cohesive color system dominated by deep mossy greens and dark neutrals, with consistent typography (one serif and one sans-serif).
Interactive elements (buttons/cards/nav items) have smooth hover/focus/active states and reduced-motion is respected when possible.
At least one section on the Home page uses an immersive textured background and at least one set of flippable cards is implemented.

requirements.text: Implement SEO-friendly structure for the React app: per-route document titles and meta descriptions derived from the page content, semantic headings (one H1 per page), accessible link/button labeling, and a crawlable internal navigation structure.

quotes: SEO-friendly layout and copy.

acceptanceCriteria: Each route sets a unique document title and meta description.
Each page uses semantic headings with a single H1.
Lighthouse SEO and Accessibility checks show no critical issues related to missing titles, missing labels, or heading order.

requirements.text: Add clickable social media integration as icon links (and/or a dedicated section) that can be configured with the creator’s profile URLs, enabling users to click out to message or view content on platforms (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube).

quotes: Social media integration (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube).
I will provide you with my social media links so they are clickable so people can go to them and message me there or watch my content there!

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend displays social icons/links in a consistent location (e.g., header/footer and/or Contact page).
Admin can set/update the social URLs without code changes (stored in backend).
All social links open in a new tab and are keyboard accessible.

requirements.text: Implement Internet Identity authentication for users (customers) and a protected Admin area. Restrict Admin access to a single admin account (the creator) using an allowlisted Internet Identity principal stored in backend settings.

quotes: One admin account should exist which is mine

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users can browse public pages; signing in uses Internet Identity.
Admin routes are blocked unless the signed-in principal matches the configured admin principal.
Backend enforces admin-only mutations regardless of frontend checks.
A settings mechanism exists to set the admin principal (initially via a backend method callable once or via an admin-only action).

requirements.text: Create an Admin panel that allows the admin to manage: Portfolio items (including photo upload), Testimonials (create/edit/delete), Shop products (create/edit/delete), pricing, in-stock/out-of-stock toggles, fulfillment options (pickup/dropoff/delivery toggles), and policies (including default “no shipping” stance but configurable).

quotes: ...create a portfolio's page and an admin page... add photos directly to the portfolio page / testimonies page...
...upload photos prices and products in stock out of stock buttons drop off pick up delivery etc etc within the admin panel...

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create/update/delete Portfolio items and upload at least one image per item.
Admin can create/update/delete Testimonials (author/name, optional handle, content, optional rating).
Admin can create/update/delete Products with fields including: name, description, price, images, stock status, and fulfillment toggles (pickup/dropoff/delivery/shipping).
Shop page reflects admin changes immediately after refresh (or via query invalidation).
A global policy/config screen allows setting defaults (e.g., shipping disabled by default) and Ashland/Westwood KY coordination messaging.

requirements.text: Build a Shop experience with (a) product browsing and detail views, (b) Stripe checkout for eligible products supporting debit/credit/digital cards, and (c) a per-product “Request quote / Contact to purchase” option that routes users to Contact and/or social links instead of checkout when enabled.

quotes: ...use stripe for payments all debit credit and digital cards are valid... along with a purchase/request quotes on certain products instead of going through the checkout system...

acceptanceCriteria: Products can be flagged as “Stripe checkout” and/or “Request quote” (both supported as configured).
Stripe checkout flow can be initiated from the Shop UI for Stripe-enabled products.
Quote-only products clearly show a primary action to request a quote/contact (no checkout required).
Orders/checkout attempts are recorded (at minimum: product, buyer principal, amount, timestamp, status) in the backend.
No shipping is required to complete checkout; fulfillment guidance is shown for local pickup/dropoff coordination.

requirements.text: Implement a Contact/Quote request system that persists submissions (from the Contact page and from quote-only product flows) for admin review, including the specified fields (Name, Email, Project Type, Timeline, Budget, Project Description) and optional linkage to a product.

quotes: Fields: Name, Email, Project Type, Timeline, Budget, Project Description.
...they can contact me directly... but they can also request them on the website...

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the contact form creates a stored ContactRequest entry in the backend.
Admin panel lists contact/quote requests with timestamps and optional associated product.
Form validates required fields and shows a success state on completion.

requirements.text: Implement coupon creation and redemption: admin can create digital coupons (code, discount type/value, validity window, usage limits), and users can apply a coupon at checkout (Stripe-enabled products) and/or have coupons awarded as loyalty rewards.

quotes: ...admin panel I can also create coupons digital coupons...

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create, update, disable, and delete coupons.
Users can apply a coupon code in the checkout flow (where applicable) and see the discount reflected before payment.
Coupon usage is validated server-side (active, not expired, within usage limits).

requirements.text: Implement a loyalty points system: users earn points from purchases and other actions (signing up, visiting, sharing), points are tracked per user, and points can be converted into rewards such as coupons/discounts/free gifts/free items after thresholds configured by admin.

quotes: ...points should convert into rewards coupons free gifts free items after so many items purchased etc etc!
...points be earned... signing up, visiting, sharing...

acceptanceCriteria: Each signed-in user has a points balance and a points activity/ledger view (at least in the admin panel; user view is preferred).
Points are awarded for: account sign-in/sign-up event, daily/visit event (rate-limited), explicit “share” button click events, and completed purchases.
Admin can configure point rules and reward thresholds (e.g., X points => award coupon Y).
Reward issuance is recorded and cannot be duplicated accidentally (idempotent).

requirements.text: Implement a giveaway system oriented around livestreams: any signed-in user can be added as an entrant (by username/identity display), entrants appear on an admin “random wheel”, and the admin can trigger a random spin to select a winner; the system records winners and timestamps.

quotes: ...any person that logs in their username will get added to a random wheel in the admin panel and when I click that wheel it will randomly select a username and that person will win the giveaway...
...through YouTube live streams tiktok live streams Facebook live streams Instagram live streams...

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create a giveaway event with a name and status (draft/active/closed).
When a giveaway is active, signed-in users can be added as entrants (automatically on login and/or via a clear user action; must be configurable).
Admin UI shows a wheel-style selector and a “Spin” action that randomly picks an entrant.
Winner is persisted (giveawayId, user, timestamp) and displayed in admin history.
Entrant list prevents duplicate entries for the same user within the same giveaway unless admin explicitly allows it.

requirements.text: Implement public Portfolio and Testimonials pages that display the admin-managed content with media (portfolio images), including interactive UI elements (e.g., filters, cards, modal/lightbox viewing for portfolio items) consistent with the site theme.

quotes: ...create a portfolio's page... testimonies page... add photos directly to the portfolio page / testimonies page...

acceptanceCriteria: Portfolio page lists items added in admin and supports viewing item details; images render correctly.
Testimonials page lists testimonials added in admin and renders well on mobile/desktop.
At least one interactive element exists on these pages (e.g., filter chips, card flip, or lightbox).

requirements.text: Support media uploads for admin-managed entities (portfolio images, product images) by storing image blobs in the backend and serving them to the frontend via stable URLs/asset endpoints, with basic limits and graceful error handling.

quotes: ...admin page I can add photos directly to the portfolio page... upload photos...

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can upload at least JPG/PNG images for products and portfolio items.
Uploaded images persist across refreshes and can be displayed in Shop/Portfolio without manual intervention.
If an upload exceeds configured limits, the UI shows a clear error message and does not corrupt state.

requirements.text: Add explicit location/service constraints messaging across Shop and relevant pages: highlight Ashland/Westwood area of Kentucky, coordination for drop-off/pickup for physical/custom/in-person jobs, and “no shipping” by default; ensure fulfillment settings and product messaging reflect these constraints.

quotes: ...coordinate a time and a place for me within the Ashland Westwood area of kentucky!
So no shipping or delivery but those should still be implemented and can be tweaked in the admin panel!

acceptanceCriteria: Shop product pages clearly communicate local coordination expectations when shipping is disabled.
Admin can toggle fulfillment modes; when shipping is disabled, UI does not present shipping as available.
Hours & Policies and/or Shop includes Ashland/Westwood KY local service area text.

requirements.text: Add a frontend static asset pipeline for generated brand imagery (logo/hero/background textures/icons) stored under frontend/public/assets/generated and used across the site (header/favicon/hero sections) without routing images through the backend.

quotes: Hero visuals: immersive medieval-fantasy inspired background... textured backgrounds...

acceptanceCriteria: All generated images are committed under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly by the frontend.
Site header uses the generated logo; Home hero uses the generated hero background texture/image.
No backend endpoint is required to serve these static assets.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend main actor file).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them only).
Do not edit immutable frontend hook paths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, .tsx, and frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx); integrate by composition/wrapping only.
No external databases or third-party auth providers; authentication must use Internet Identity.
No WebSockets/real-time chat; giveaway and points updates are driven by standard requests and polling/invalidation where needed.
nonGoals: Embedded social media feeds via platform APIs (Instagram/TikTok/Facebook API integrations).
Shipping label purchasing, carrier integrations, or real-world logistics automation.
Advanced CMS features like versioning, approvals, or scheduled publishing.

required: Medieval-fantasy hero background with deep mossy greens, dark tones, subtle texture (hero-bg.dim_2400x1350.png)
Seamless parchment/stone textured background pattern in dark moss/charcoal palette (texture-tile.dim_1024x1024.png)
Elegant crest-style logo mark for “The Creator of Side Quests” (logo-crest.dim_512x512.png)
Small icon set in matching style: sword, quill, potion, compass (icons-set.dim_256x256.png)
Wide banner texture for page headers with subtle ornament and vignette (page-banner.dim_2400x600.png)
